Message.En:
<COL ffdc78>[Appraisal Exchange]</COL> specific Items can be
exchanged for Special Items.
The items required are often
difficult to obtain or craft.
<COL ffdc78>But the items obtained are very valuable and
often have special effects.</COL>
If you want to get stronger, then try to obtain
or craft the requested items.
